why: Reject-to-null dropped, so `?dev=1&stockCue=chip` becomes a `StockCue` the HUD does not branch on (issue #230). `fillStockCueEntry` treats anything that is not `pips` or `strike` as the badge, so a typo -- or `chip`, the dropped mockup -- would quietly show the badge while the URL named something else. The same guard `arrival`, `shellTrail` and the other arm flags carry.
